categories_review.source: README Supported features and docs/features.md: connects ESPHome Device Builder, compiles ESPHome firmware, verifies and publishes OTA binaries, and manages device firmware updates through a HA sidebar. Primary computers_network covers the actual computing/firmware tooling use across ESPHome devices; no specific end-device product class or cloud developer service is claimed.

descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that builds and publishes ESPHome firmware over HTTP OTA through the ESPHome Device Builder add-on’s trusted loopback listener. It needs no public port, `leave_front_door_open` setting or login token.
descriptions.ko: ESPHome Device Builder 애드온의 신뢰 루프백 리스너를 사용해 펌웨어를 HTTP OTA로 빌드·게시하는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다. 공개 포트, `leave_front_door_open` 설정, 로그인 토큰 없이 연결합니다.
